import path from "node:path";

export class Runner {
  count = 0;
  static #instances = 0;

  constructor(options) {
    secretOptions(options);
  }

  run(task) {
    secretRun(task);
  }
}

export function start(argv) {
  return secretStart(argv);
}

function* ids() {
  yield secretId();
}

const stop = function () {
  secretStop();
};
